# SKILL-3 Test Suite (TDD RED) — Staffing Matcher

**NULogic SkillSync · Stage 07-tests · Generated by `nulogic-test-creator` · 2026-06-09 · Status: RED**

The Staffing Matcher turns a plain-English query into a deterministic, role-scoped
profile dataset → a single **Opus** Claude call (ranking rules + dataset cached) →
a Zod-validated `MatchResult` → four response branches. This suite is the binding
contract for that behaviour and is intentionally **failing** until the GREEN phase
(`nulogic-code-writer`) implements the modules.

All "intelligence" (ranking + availability reasoning) is a real Claude call (BR-09).
Tests inject a **stubbed** Claude client — no live API calls — and assert the call
boundary, the validated shape, the result *relationship*, graceful failure, and
role-scope. They never assert keyword/regex/date logic.

- **18 failing** — the feature behaviour, failing for the RIGHT reason:

  - 5 fail on the **unmet schema contract** — they load the existing SKILL-1 `MatchResult` *stub* (which exists) and fail because it does not yet implement the §2.5 + `z.preprocess` coercion (TACTICAL-ADR-S3-05): canonical `{results}` rejected, bare array rejected, `{shortlist}` rejected, in-range bare array rejected, and the legacy `{matches}` shape still (wrongly) accepted.
- **1 passing** — `S3-P0-01` is the **RED-state sanity check**: it asserts the F-01 helper imports resolve and that `loadModule('@/lib/match/run-staffing-search')` *rejects*. Its passing proves the harness is wired and the core is genuinely absent — it is not a feature assertion.

## Scenarios (GIVEN · WHEN · THEN)

### Phase 0 — Baseline
**S3-P0-01** (BR-09)
GIVEN `test-helpers.ts` now exports `loadModule` + `SYNTHETIC_PROFILES` alongside the three Claude doubles
WHEN the suite runs before the core exists
THEN the helper imports resolve (F-01 closed) and `loadModule('@/lib/match/run-staffing-search')` rejects — a meaningful RED, no live Anthropic call.

### Phase 1 — Schema + prompt contract
**S3-P1-01** (AC-04/05/21 · BR-05/BR-09)
GIVEN the four payload encodings the authored test scripts (canonical `{results}`, bare array, `{shortlist}`-keyed) plus negatives (legacy `{matches}`, out-of-range `matchPercent`)
WHEN `MatchResult.safeParse` runs (the schema's `z.preprocess(coerceModelShape,…)` runs before the inner object validation, mirroring `callClaude` `claude.ts:132`)
THEN `{results}` validates with all BR-05 fields; the bare array and `{shortlist}` coerce to `{results}` (shortfallNote preserved); the legacy `{matches}` shape fails; and an in-range bare array validates while `matchPercent:250` fails — proving coercion did NOT weaken entry-level validation (BR-09 intact).

**S3-P1-02** (AC-04 · BR-04/BR-12)
GIVEN the `match-staffing` template + the assembled `cacheableContext` (RANKING_RULES_PROMPT + serialized dataset)
WHEN `runStaffingSearch` assembles the call
THEN the ranking rules + dataset appear in the cached `system` arg, the per-request query is the only content in the user turn, and the dataset is NOT leaked into the user turn (F-03).

### Phase 2 — Role-scoped deterministic dataset builder
**S3-P2-01** (AC-11 · BR-03) — PL dataset == exactly its team (leadId == caller.id); no org leak.
**S3-P2-02** (AC-11 · BR-03) — an Employee session yields a Denied marker; no org dataset built; no downstream Claude call.
**S3-P2-03** (AC-04 · BR-12) — `serializeDataset` is byte-identical for identical input (prompt-cache + loop before/after reuse).
**S3-P2-04** (AC-11 · BR-03) — a PL with no team yields an empty dataset, never an error.

### Phase 3 — Matching core + four branches
**S3-P3-01** (AC-04 · BR-04/05/09/12 — *happy*)
GIVEN two candidates with IDENTICAL skill overlap differing ONLY in availability (p-002 free now / in-window; p-001 free ~6 weeks / out-of-window), the Claude double scripted with a bare array of equal `matchPercent`
WHEN `runStaffingSearch` runs
THEN the boundary is called exactly once; `ok`; each entry has matchPercent/matchedSkills/gaps/availability/rationale; and the in-window candidate ranks above the equally-skilled out-of-window one (lower `rank`, earlier index, correct `inRequestedWindow`) — proving **availability**, not skills, drove ordering.

**S3-P3-02** (AC-05 · BR-05 — *hard match*) — niche query; the shortlist is non-empty and the top entry carries explicit gaps[] / ramp-up — never empty.

**S3-P3-03** (AC-21 · BR-05 — *partial quantity*) — a `{shortlist,shortfallNote}` payload yields 2 results (coerced, not silently dropped) with `shortfallNote` matching `/2 of 3/`.

**S3-P3-04** (AC-06 · BR-09 — *failure*) — Claude throws → `ok:false`, exact message `"Search is temporarily unavailable — please retry."`, no shortlist exposed.

**S3-P3-05** (AC-06 · BR-09 — *failure, ADDITIVE*) — garbled JSON fails the Zod/extract gate → same retry message, never repaired into a ranking. Covers the second distinct `callClaude` failure reason (F-06).

**S3-P3-06** (AC-04 · BR-12) — the boundary is invoked with the Opus model id (`route('hard')`, matches `/opus/i`) and a cached `system` context carrying both the ranking rules and the dataset.

### Phase 4 — Read-only transport + role gate
**S3-P4-01** (AC-11 · BR-03) — an Employee is denied via the dataset path before any model call; the injected double is never invoked.
**S3-P4-02** (AC-06 · BR-09) — a core failure surfaces the retry message with no results (read-only; no DB write).

## Performance tests

Not applicable. SKILL-3 is a single injected Claude call with no DB writes; latency is
model-dominated and mitigated via prompt caching + a SKILL-6 loading state. No backend
throughput/batch surface to load-test.
